messages:
lucas: FYI canary with the new composite-index format failed on one node: loader picked index-v2 but bundle was produced with mixed safetensors+gzip shards and index entries pointed to compressed segments.
maria: ouch. did the loader detect compression tag and switch decompress path?
lucas: it tried, but index-v2 included a field compress=auto and our backward compat path treated unknown codec as raw. ended up publishing garbage.
kevin: we need a compatibility-level negotiation in the manifest. something like compat_level: 1|2 and index_schema: v1|v2. loader should refuse unknown schema unless feature-flagged.
nina: also need a graceful fallback chain: (1) try index-first using declared schema; (2) if schema mismatch -> attempt schema-shim probe that only fetches first chunk and validates checksum/tag; (3) if probe fails -> fallback to STREAM_SAFE legacy reader.
maria: agree. semantics: manifest fields: 
  "index_schema": "v2",
  "compat_level": "2",
  "shard_codecs": ["safetensors","zstd-gzip"]
loader should expose loader.probe_schema(url)->OK/REJECT so orchestration can decide canary rollout.
kevin: runtime policy: by default refuse auto-upgrade. rollout plan: 1) add loader.probe_schema + telemetry 2) ship feature-flag allowing index_schema=v2 in canary 3) if probe fails, surface clear error instead of publishing partial.
lucas: edge-case: mixed bundles where some shards are gzipped and others safetensors. we should allow per-shard codec tags and require the index to list codec per-chunk. that way reader picks per-chunk decode.
nina: performance note: per-chunk codec adds overhead. we should allow a compressed-summary table for common codec + fallback. telemetry to measure percent-of-mixed-bundles.
dev-bot: created INF-9012: composite-index-compat-shim + probe API; ETA 3 sprints.
maria: loader API additions: probe_schema(uri) -> {schema_version, codecs_present}, can_accept(schema_version)->bool, probe_fetch_first_chunk(uri, chunk_idx)->checksum_ok. also add explicit publish_abort_on_schema_mismatch flag.
kevin: security: ensure probe only validates headers and first N bytes to avoid decompressing huge craft payloads. limit probe decompress to 4MB.
lucas: rollout note: add the schema field to manifest generator in the training pipeline; if unknown codec appears, pipeline must fail the bundle. that prevents surprises.
nina: tests: create mixed-bundle fixtures with v1/v2 indices and run canary harness across 50 nodes. ensure probe_schema prevents wrong publish.
maria: ok I'll draft RFC follow-up focusing on: manifest negotiation, loader.probe_schema, publish-fail-fast semantics, and rollout checklist. link when WIP: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/index-negotiation (WIP).
kevin: thanks. small aside: for private deployments, add an admin override to allow forcing v2 for early adopter tenants, behind a knob. but require explicit opt-in.
lucas: good. I'll start a small patch adding probe_schema and the feature-flag.
